messages.author: d6ffe8b5633d6bb1
messages.subject: Feature request for emailing apps
parts:
Hello,

My team at the company I work for would find it very useful to have emails periodically delivered to our inboxes that shows a given app at its current state. We're basically looking for a snapshot of the app currently running on Shiny server and have it sent to our inboxes, perhaps on a fixed schedule.

Is there any option to do that at the moment, or is that a feature that can be considered for the enterprise version?

Thank you!

Alan
